mapper.select: SELECT * FROM TBL_BILL_DISCOUNT WHERE DISCOUNT_ID = #{discountId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0
SELECT * FROM TBL_BILL_DISCOUNT WHERE DISCOUNT_NUMBER = #{discountNumber} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0

SELECT DISCOUNT_ID AS RECORD_ID, BILL_ID AS BILL_ID, 'DISCOUNT' AS RECORD_TYPE, '贴现' AS RECORD_TYPE_NAME, APPLICANT_NAME AS FROM_HOLDER, DISCOUNT_BANK AS TO_HOLDER, ACTUAL_DISCOUNT_DATE AS TRANSACTION_TIME, APPLICANT_NAME AS OPERATOR_NAME, BILL_AMOUNT AS AMOUNT, DISCOUNT_STATUS AS STATUS, REMARK FROM TBL_BILL_DISCOUNT WHERE BILL_ID = #{billId} AND DELETE_FLAG = 0 AND DISCOUNT_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' AND ACTUAL_DISCOUNT_DATE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY ACTUAL_DISCOUNT_DATE DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalcount, SUM(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pendingcount, SUM(CASE WHEN DISCOUNT_STATUS = 'COMPLETED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS completedcount, COALESCE(SUM(DISCOUNT_AMOUNT), 0) AS totalamount FROM TBL_BILL_DISCOUNT WHERE DELETE_FLAG = 0
AND DISCOUNT_STATUS = #{query.discountStatus}
AND BILL_NUMBER LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.billNumber}, '%')
AND DISCOUNT_BANK LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query.discountBank}, '%')
